title: Elevator, 18th Floor
description:
The elevator in a Gangnam office tower stopped.

The button for floor 18 was lit.
The man standing beside {name}. Early forties. Seen on the news a few times.
President of a group subsidiary. The one his grandfather built.

90 seconds.

This man's dress shirt costs more than {name}'s monthly food budget.
The floor this man is going to is the floor {name} is trying to reach — in a different sense.

The elevator hummed upward.

choices.text: Speak first. Made it this far.
choices.result_text:
'Do you come to this building often?' The words came out.

The man glanced over. 'Oh — yes.' Short.

Handed over a card. He took it. Glanced at it.
Floor 18. The doors opened. 'Take care.' Gone.

A week later, {name} sent a text:
'This is the person you met in the elevator...'

Read. No reply.

The card is still in the inside pocket of the wallet.

Held out the card.

He took it. Looked once. Put it in his pocket.
Seemed about to say something. Didn't.

Floor 18. Doors opened.

That was it.

Where that card is now — wonders sometimes.
Thrown away, or passed to someone, or just — forgotten.

choices.text: Pretend not to notice. Different worlds anyway.
choices.result_text:
Head down, phone out.

He looked at his phone too.
90 seconds. Neither said a word.

Floor 18. Doors opened. He walked out.

The back of his shoes was visible for a moment.
Not a scuff on them.

Someone made those shoes.
That person is somewhere, building toward something too.

The elevator doors closed.

title: Health Check Results
description: The results from the annual check-up arrived in the app. Two items flagged 'Caution.' Always tired, yes — but not expecting this. Hand trembled slightly.

choices.text: Read the results. Start with diet.
choices.result_text: Saw the numbers and cleaned out the fridge the same day. Health is something you protect before it breaks.

choices.text: Can't face it. Stuff the printout in a drawer.
choices.result_text: Out of sight, out of mind. The body knows, even if the eyes don't.

choices.text: The test is wrong. Demand a retest.
choices.result_text: Refused to accept it. Went to a different hospital. Denial is a defense mechanism too.

title: Gangnam Open House
description:
Saw a listing and walked in on impulse.

New construction in Gangnam. Open house.

107 sqm. Listed at ₩1,850,000,000.

Seoul was visible through the living room windows.
A staff member gave the pitch. Han River view. School district. Transit links.

The couple standing nearby was nodding.
They were people who could live here.

{name} was standing in that living room.
Feet touching the floor.
That, strangely, felt very real.

choices.text: Ask the staff about financing. Might come back someday.
choices.result_text:
'What's the maximum loan I could get?'

The staff ran the numbers. Income basis, asset basis, rates.

{name} wrote it down.
A cold, clear look at the distance between those numbers and where {name} stands now.

Took a brochure on the way out.
Put it in a desk drawer.

Had a feeling it would be opened again.

Walked out.

Heading toward the subway, {name} kept thinking about the living room just left behind.
That floor. That window. That height.

₩1,850,000,000 came out of the building attached.

Got on the subway.
Sat down. Closed eyes.

The feeling of standing in that room stayed for a long time.
The soles of the feet still seemed to remember the floor.
